summary: Junie by JetBrains is a coding agent installed from the terminal. Its homepage describes Junie Lite as a free model on every JetBrains account with no card needed, and the official FAQ says the offer is valid until 31 Dec 2026. The Free to Start plan is listed as Free, with other AI usage billed separately; bring-your-own-key usage is billed at provider rates with zero markup.
claim_steps: Open a terminal and run the install command from junie.jetbrains.com: curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash
Sign in with your JetBrains Account to use the free Junie Lite model

social_proof.title: Junie
social_proof.text: Junie Lite is a free model on every JetBrains account, no card needed. When a task needs a frontier model, bring your own key and pay the provider’s rate with no markup from us, or use AI credits from AI Pro or AI Ultimate. Terms and available models may change. Offer is valid until 31 Dec 2026.
